question.problem:
The matrix $H$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(H).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$, where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{h}_{1}+{x}_{2}{h}_{2},$ and ${h}_{1},$ ${h}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $H.$

$$
H=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(H),$ we need to check if the equation $Hx=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[H\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[H\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=7 \\ {x}_{2}=2 \\ 0=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get the false statement $0=-2.$ 

Therefore, the system is inconsistent, which implies that $b\notin \text{Col}(H).$
